dct_title_s: Iran (Islamic Republic of) - Earthquake on Aug 05 2025
dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[sm\_us6000qy6g](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_eq_events/items?uid=sm_us6000qy6g) Magnitude 5.4 earthquake at 56.726 depth occurred on Aug 05 2025 70km S of Mohammadabad-E Rigan. The epicentre of the earthquake was located at latitude 28.0285 longitude 59.0845. It impacted 37403 people within 50km. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
